annotations.title: Check Supabase migrations for RLS and grant gaps

description:
Review Supabase migration changes for missing RLS or policies, unrestricted read/write policies, exposed security definer functions and Data API grant gaps. Pass file contents: sql contains one migration's SQL text; files contains path and content for each file. Runs the VibeRaven 1.7.2 SQL rules and returns finding id, severity, file, line, a suggested fix and a guide link. For missing Data API grants, include the migration revoking default privileges or supabase/config.toml, plus browser files using supabase.from(...) (a "use client" file, or src files with package.json for Vite).
Limits: supplied text only, up to 200 KB/50 files; cannot access your repository or database, does not execute SQL, and does not store or log file contents.

files.description: Several files: .sql migrations, and optionally supabase/config.toml, package.json and browser code files.

content.description: The full text of the file.

path.description: The file path in the repo, for example supabase/migrations/20260101000000_init.sql. Migrations run in file name order.

sql.description: The SQL text of one migration file.

name: check_supabase_migrations
